integrity: Analytic dominated-convergence proof with reproducible finite quadrature diagnostics; no assertion of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite N>=3, zero-drift independent Brownian coordinates, positive individual triggering levels, complete simultaneous regeneration; fixed positive excursion directions; no N-uniform asymptotic. General regenerative mixture theory may yield implicit coverage.
title: Heterogeneous threshold-resetting gas: exact joint negative tails and threshold-free extremal dependence
